changes: Strong typed serverconfig authority; detached core projection; strict current schema and fields; no old schema/API migration.
WebSocket path/host/early-data round trips, explicit validation, and core header mode for encoded paths without enabling early data.
Explicit account repository/config/core ownership; protocol CI fixture now passes the core validator.
Adjacent account task batches of at most 16, ordered barriers, independent outcomes and one final credential reconciliation; no protocol hot update.
Structured HTTP errors and generated Go-to-JS API boundary types with a drift check; no full UI TypeScript migration.
Immutable parser validation inside bounded compilation cache; authorization and binary/file validation remain outside.
Cancellable task dialogs, contextual lazy template resources, complete supported node fields and responsive layout.
Eight test-only helpers removed from production compilation; current architecture/development/usage documents updated.
